description: The forecast narrator (spec 006, FR-024). Explains a chart whose every figure the platform already computed; states no figure of its own.

guardrail.note: Attached by infra. Principle II names guardrails as part of the GenAI layer, and the narrator's input is a tenant's spend and capacity figures.

actionGroups.name: forecast-read
actionGroups.description: Read-only forecast lookups through the platform HTTP API. Every operation is a GET; the agent principal is refused on every other method (FR-056, R-602).

info.title: Narrator forecast reads
info.description: One operation. The narrator is handed the chart's figures in its prompt; this endpoint exists so it can read the same projections for context, and returns nothing the prompt did not already declare. No spend or metrics endpoints: a number read there and not declared in the prompt is unresolvable by definition and discards the narrative (FR-024).

get.summary: Per-project spend and capacity forecasts, with backtested error.
get.description: Read this for the shape of the projections. Every figure you may state was supplied in the prompt; this endpoint returning more precision, more projects, or an intermediate value does not license stating it.
